scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of her account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Lakisha Jackson and I'm 81. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Lakisha. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot pull up your account using just your name. Could you please provide your full mailing address and the last four digits of the credit card you used for the purchase?
Oh, that's a bit much, but okay. My address is 442 Oak Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you for that information. I have located an account matching those details. Per our standard security policy, I need to verify one more thing—can you confirm the approximate date of the transaction you are looking to have refunded?
I believe it was sometime late last month, maybe the 25th or 26th? It was for a kitchen appliance I never received.

I see the transaction here from October 26th. Since this involves a missing shipment and an account access issue, I'm going to go ahead and process that refund for you now. It should appear on your statement within 3-5 business days.
Oh, thank you so much! That is a huge relief.
You're welcome. I've successfully processed the refund of $89.99 back to your card. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

resolution_summary: Verified customer identity via address and partial payment info; located transaction and processed refund for undelivered item.
